hook_en: Your photo is 3 MB but the form wants 20-50 KB. Fix it in 10 seconds.
hook_hinglish: Photo 3 MB ki hai aur form ko 20-50 KB chahiye. 10 second mein fix.
angle: A job seeker has minutes before the application closes and the photo keeps getting rejected, then the resize turns the error red into a green success.

hook_en: Open your Aadhaar PDF without remembering the password rule.
hook_hinglish: Aadhaar PDF khol lo, bina password ka chakkar yaad kiye.
angle: A character is locked out of the e-Aadhaar file and tries wrong passwords, then the tool opens it in three taps.

hook_en: 5 PDF problems you can solve for free, starting with this one.
hook_hinglish: 5 PDF problems jo free mein solve ho jaati hain, pehli yeh wali.
angle: A narrator and a counter run through five tiny scenes, with merging ten scanned pages into one file as scene one.

hook_en: Your bank statement PDF can turn into Excel in one tap. Nobody tells you this.
hook_hinglish: Bank statement PDF ek tap mein Excel ban jaata hai. Koi batata nahi.
angle: An intern is retyping a long statement by hand while a colleague quietly shows the converter, and the rows fill in a table at once.

hook_en: Signature must be 10-20 KB? Stop re-clicking photos of your signature.
hook_hinglish: Signature 10-20 KB chahiye? Baar baar signature ki photo khichna band karo.
angle: A junior keeps getting a rejected upload from the boss's portal, and the boss shows the signature resizer that gets a green tick.

hook_en: Same PDF, same form. First try: 'file too large'. Second try: uploaded in 3 seconds.
hook_hinglish: Same PDF, same form. Pehli baar: 'file too large'. Doosri baar: 3 second mein upload.
angle: A student's 6 MB PDF gets rejected by the portal. He runs it through Compress PDF, the panel shows 6 MB to 190 KB, and the form goes through.

hook_en: 3 form photo problems that take 10 seconds to fix, and all of them are free.
hook_hinglish: Form ke 3 photo problems jo 10 second mein fix ho jaate hain, aur sab free.
angle: A job seeker hits three rejections in a row (signature too big, photo too big, wrong format). Each gets fixed in turn with a size panel, and we finish with 'save this for your next form'.

hook_en: Your Aadhaar PDF is locked, and nobody tells you the password is already hiding in plain sight.
hook_hinglish: Aapka Aadhaar PDF locked hai, aur kisi ne nahi bataya ki password toh pehle se aapke paas hai.
angle: A character is stuck on the password prompt. The reveal: the password follows a known pattern. The tool opens it in one step and the unlocked PDF shows up on screen.

hook_en: The easiest way to make a passport photo at home: upload, tap, done.
hook_hinglish: Ghar par passport photo banane ka sabse easy tareeka: upload, tap, done.
angle: A character skips the photo studio queue. Three steps (upload selfie, auto-crop to size, download) with the result panel showing the correct dimensions and size.

hook_en: Uploading 5 PDFs one by one vs uploading 1. Watch the difference.
hook_hinglish: 5 PDF ek-ek karke upload karna vs 1 PDF upload karna. Difference dekho.
angle: A job seeker wastes minutes attaching five documents to an application. Replay it: Merge PDF combines them into one file and the form accepts it first time.

hook_en: 3 things you can do with one photo and no editing skills.
hook_hinglish: Ek photo se 3 cheezein jo bina editing seekhe ho jaati hain.
angle: One selfie turns into a clean white-background ID photo, a profile picture and a sticker, each shown as a panel with a success tick.

hook_en: What happens when your bank statement PDF turns into Excel in one click?
hook_hinglish: Kya hoga jab aapka bank statement PDF ek click mein Excel ban jaaye?
angle: A character is typing numbers from a PDF by hand at midnight. What if the tool did it? The table appears in Excel, sorted and ready.
